_description: Pension income exceeds spending with no taxable account — simulation auto-creates 'Reinvestment' taxable account to absorb surplus.
_rationale: $50k/yr pension (after_tax) into Florida (no state tax) with $20k/yr living expenses, no portfolio growth, no inflation, no income tax. After-tax income = 50k, spending = 20k, surplus = 30k/yr. With no taxable account in UserData, ensureReinvestmentAccount injects a $0 'Reinvestment' taxable account. After 5 years, surplus accumulates to 5×30k = 150k in the synthetic taxable account; existing $0 Roth stays $0. Without auto-create, surplus would silently vanish.
name: Surplus Auto Create Taxable
